name: attribution-badge
description: Engine-family 'Powered by' attribution mark. Two-line stacked pill: uppercase micro-label ('Powered by') over the engine-family wordmark. Deliberately unthemed — a certification mark, not a themed UI component, so it reads identically regardless of the hosting site's own color scheme. Exactly one visible badge per engine FAMILY (mediakit, privategit); the specific engine variant (knowledge/marketing/source/marketplace/bim) is exposed via the title= tooltip attribute, never as a separate visible mark or additional badge.

variants.name: mediakit
variants.description: family='mediakit', familyName='MediaKit'. Variant metadata (knowledge/marketing) supplied via {{tooltip}} only.

variants.name: privategit
variants.description: family='privategit', familyName='PrivateGit'. Variant metadata (source/marketplace/bim) supplied via {{tooltip}} only.

data_source: factory-release-engineering/tokens/attribution-badges.yaml — label text and link destination are NOT owned by this component; this recipe defines shape/CSS only. See families.<name>.label / families.<name>.link / families.<name>.variants.<variant>.tooltip.
aria: Standard <a href> with a descriptive title= attribute carrying the engine-variant tooltip (e.g. 'MediaKit Knowledge Engine v0.3'). No additional ARIA needed — the visible label + family name already convey the link's purpose; title= is supplementary metadata, not the sole accessible name.
